method: Independent coarse manual readings from each actual quantized frame coordinate grid (20px grid, native/2x nearest-neighbor views). Integer estimates deliberately reflect landmark ambiguity; no subpixel precision claimed. H=crown-to-chin; T=collar-to-garment hem; A=selected visible shoulder/elbow/wrist chain; L=selected visible hip/knee/ankle chain; S=heel/toe when unambiguous. Bounds and contact rectangles are exact in frozen-atlas-evidence.json. This table is not an automated anatomy gate.
